record.provider: FOSSVPS / ST-Hosting — free VPS for open-source developers (Frankfurt, Buffalo, LA, Chisinau)

free_tier.stated: Free VPSs on donated hardware; the Frankfurt node is an AMD EPYC 7402P, 128 GiB RAM, 1 TB SSD donated by ST-Hosting for at least two years. Per-VM disk is small (the node is large, the slices are not).

egress.terms: Node-level 1 Gbps; per-VM transfer not published. Unverified.

record.limits_note: Per-VM disk is far below 500 GB. Node end-dates are published (Moldova to 2027-01-31, Buffalo to 2026-11-22, LA to 2026-12-21). The infrastructure has an expiry date.
record.reliability_note: Donated capacity with published sunset dates and a public status page. Structurally temporary even when the VM is free.

evidence.proved: 'an AMD EPYC 7402P 24-Core Processor with 128GiB RAM and 1TB SSD'; 'Free and open source software developers only … No excessive high cpu, disk or bandwidth'; node end dates to 2026/2027
